report: Successfully generated build_database.py. The script implements the requested algorithm: it parses .dna files using Bio.SeqIO with 'snapgene' format, filters features by specific labels and location types (SimpleLocation with ExactPosition start/end), validates sequence content (DNA bases only, length >=12), deduplicates entries, calculates SHA256 hashes for sequences and file sources, and outputs up to 15 canonical JSON records. It includes error handling for parsing failures via stderr printing and raises an error if no valid entries are found after processing all files.
